noah_ar: Heads up: ACH return for INV-2026-509 (HelioMetrics) $5,420. Return code R03 (no account). Batch ach_9981 failed.
maria_billing: ugh. do we have backup payment method?
kate_sales: customer notes they're moving banks and asked for a short defer while they update payment method. CFO offered to pay 40% today and remaining 60% in 30 days.
ryan_ops: system shows no saved card and no prior returns. attaching webhook: ```{"return_code":"R03","amount":5420,"tx":"ach_9981","ts":"2026-03-10T09:05:12Z"}```
sophie_support: i emailed customer payment link and requested signed installment agreement; asked for ACH re-init after account update. they replied saying they'd prefer card if ACH won't go through.
maria_billing: policy: one manual ACH retry for R03 within 5 business days. for partial payments need approval from finance + legal. @lena_legal can we accept 2-installment plan with card fallback?
lena_legal: yes, legal ok with 2-installment plan if we get a signed agreement and explicit consent for card fallback. use template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/installment-agreement. log waiver as "exceptions/ACH-card-fallback".
noah_ar: i'll take the call with CFO at 2026-03-10 11:30 PT to confirm authorization. will request signed consent and card on file.
collections_bot: Invoice INV-2026-509 status set to "negotiation_hold". Next dunning step paused until 2026-03-15.
maria_billing: action items: 1) schedule ACH retry 2026-03-11 if we get updated bank details; 2) if retry fails, process 40% via card on file; 3) create AR watch ticket and set reminder 3/17. assigning to noah_ar + maria_billing.
noah_ar: called CFO, got verbal commitment for 40% today and card details to follow. CFO will sign agreement and upload before EOD 3/10. will post signed pdf here.
sophie_support: customer uploaded signed consent and card tokenized on profile. proceeding to schedule retry and token charge fallback.
maria_billing: scheduled manual retry 2026-03-11 08:00 PST. if retry fails, we'll charge card token for $2,168 (40%) then set remaining invoices on autopay. closing thread unless charge returns. closing ts 1973339123"
